entry.title: Useful Machine Learning ressources
entry.content:
This page is dedicated to all the Machine Learning ressources I have used during my studies and that I still use today. Listing them here is a way to pay tribute to all the great person that produced them.

Books

Introduction to Machine Learning concepts

If you want to learn about statistical Machine Learning concepts like Regression, Classification, Kernel Methods or Neural Networks

  • Murphy, K. P. (2022). Probabilistic machine learning: an introduction. MIT press. from Kevin Patrick Murphy
  • Bishop, C. M., & Nasrabadi, N. M. (2006). Pattern recognition and machine learning (Vol. 4, No. 4, p. 738). New York: springer. from Christopher M. Bishop

Introduction to Deep Learning concepts

  • The one that taught me everything about Deep Learning : Aggarwal, C. C. (2018). Neural networks and deep learning (Vol. 10, No. 978, p. 3). Cham: springer. from Charu C. Aggarwal

  • Murphy, K. P. (2023). Probabilistic machine learning: Advanced topics. MIT press. from Kevin Patrick Murphy

  • The logical next step to the first great book : Bishop, C. M., & Bishop, H. (2024). Deep learning: Foundations and concepts (Vol. 1). Cham, Switzerland: Springer.

Introduction to Reinforcement Learning concepts

  • Plaat, A. (2022). Deep reinforcement learning (Vol. 10, pp. 978-981). Singapore: Springer. available on arXiv for free

Videos

Online Deep Learning course from CNRS

The CNRS deployed this great ressource that I recommend to dive into if you want to start in Deep Learning but you do know how : Fiddle Deep Learning
